title: `getGroupIdsWithViewPermission()` returns authz resource UUIDs, not group IDs
description: Returns authz resource UUIDs instead of group IDs; admin with view-members/manage-members on all groups gets bogus IDs, causing GET /admin/realms/{realm}/users to return zero users. Fix: use resource name instead of ID in both `hasPermission()` call and `granted.add()`.

title: `GroupPermissionsV2.canManage()` grants group creation on a view-only permission
description: Admin holding only all-groups view scope permission can create top-level groups via `addTopLevelGroup()`. Fix: return `hasPermission(null, AdminPermissionsSchema.MANAGE)` to check MANAGE scope only, removing the VIEW clause.
